evidence: tools/green_check.py:353-357 `names = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--name-only", base, "--", "books", "tests/acl2"], ...)` and `return sorted(name[:-5] for name in names if name.endswith(".lisp"))`. Books do include host files: books/image-world-dtn.lisp:158 `(include-book "../host/page-read-host")` and five admission-semantic-census-*-refinement books include ../host/admission-semantic-census-host. certs.closure follows those edges, and dependents() (:361-379) itself notes that "Host include files contribute dependency bytes".
fix: Diff every path that can appear in any audited book's closure (in practice, add host/ or use the closure's own key set), and add `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- books tests/acl2 host`. Then compute dependents over every changed closure member, not only those under books/ and tests/acl2.
reviewer: changed_books (green_check.py:346-357) diffs only `books` and `tests/acl2` against the merge base. host/*.lisp edits are therefore invisible, even though books include them: books/admission-semantic-census-*-refinement.lisp:2-7 include ../host/admission-semantic-census-host, and image-world-dtn includes ../host/page-read-host. dependents() (:361-379) only searches for closures reaching `wanted`, so an empty changed list yields not_green==[] and exit 0. `git diff <base>` without --untracked does not list new untracked files, which contradicts the docstring's claim that the working tree is judged. The gate is the documented merge gate (green_check.py:21, how-we-work.md). Under the land-and-fix-forward mode its weight is reduced, but the false green is real.
scenario: A lane edits host/page-read-host.lisp only. changed_books returns [], dependents() is computed over an empty `wanted`, and the gate prints "no book or test book differs from the merge base" with not_green == []. `--changed-since dev --strict` exits 0, although image-world-dtn's include closure changed and nothing has certified it. In a second case, a lane creates books/x.lisp without `git add`. `git diff <base>` does not list untracked files, so the new book escapes the gate, even though the docstring says the working tree is what is judged.
title: green_check --changed-since merge gate misses host files that books include and new untracked books
